findings.title: No fiducials, and the standard assembly service needs them
findings.detail: Three or four 1 mm copper fiducials in a 2 mm mask opening, 3.35 mm or more from the edge (or on the panel's rails).
findings.fix: Add fiducials (Fiducial footprints) or ask for them on the panel rails

findings.title: The narrowest track, 0.1 mm meets the fab's 0.09 mm, under the recommended 0.127 mm
findings.detail: Not a must-change. Source of the fab's limit: https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities, read 2026-11-21.
findings.fix: Widen it where there is room

findings.title: The smallest via hole, 0.2 mm meets the fab's 0.2 mm, under the recommended 0.3 mm
findings.detail: Not a must-change. Source of the fab's limit: https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities, read 2026-11-21.

findings.title: No Gerber and drill files in mfg/ yet
findings.detail: A buy thread exports them when it orders; nothing to check before.

findings.title: Parts on both sides (75 on top, 27 on the bottom)

findings.fix: Move the bottom parts to the top where they fit, or order the standard service
